title: Sport opportunities
description: We believe sport creates opportunities for connection, confidence and growth within the youth. Therefore, we aim to make sports more accessible to young people across Vietnam, fostering new communities through participation, athletic development and competition.
points: Variation in sporting events and tournaments
Opportunities to connect with coaches & sporting figures through mentorship and engagement

title: Creative opportunities
description: We strive to elevate the arts by providing platforms for talented young creatives to pursue excellence, gain recognition, and showcase their work. GUV aims to connect emerging talent with new creative opportunities.
points: Competitive dance events and performance showcases
Curated art exhibitions, auctions with fundraising initiatives
Engagement with established artists and industry professionals
